title: Shared reference register including RSL systems
scope: Add RSL systems (online_refunds, audit_system, psrm, etax, idms, asycuda) to the canonical service links and expose one case reference card (RSL claim, TIN, RSL audit case, Vati case, Jube case, OpenAleph collection) to every Vati surface

acceptance.text: Vati Service Link accepts the RSL services with the same tenant and conflict rules
A case reference endpoint returns every mapped reference the caller may see
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

evidence.text: ids.canonical adds online_refunds, audit_system, psrm, etax, idms and asycuda (ADR-052) with record types from the TAX-111 contracts: one RSL claim and one RSL audit case per case; returns, invoices, entries and PSRM records many. Vati Service Link options updated; the same link/slot/event keys enforce tenant and conflict rules. A TIN is not a link (shared across a taxpayer's cases). The TAX-123 referral intake records the audit_system link and the TAX-122 Online Refunds intake the claim link; conflicts are reported as refused. Patch v0_4.link_rsl_references backfills older references. ids/test_canonical.py 33 OK (6 new: types, one-per-case, already-mapped, many returns, tenant separation); bench test_mapping_bench 13/13, test_rsl_referrals_bench 8/8 (links recorded and replayed, backfill, officer card across tenants), test_rsl_intake_bench 7/7.

vati_tax.references builds one case reference card (tenant, Vati case and display ID, masked TIN, RSL claim, RSL audit case, Jube case, OpenAleph collection, other RSL records). Officers: GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/references (getCaseReferences; case.read plus the TAX-142 refund gate), served by the fixture server too (example 49). Taxpayers: portal.api.get_case_references by their own submission or evidence request; the taxpayer view hides Jube, OpenAleph and the RSL record list exactly as if absent. ServiceLink.service accepts RslServiceName so getCase returns RSL links. references/test_rules.py 8 OK; tests/contracts 140 OK incl. test_case_references.py 5; bench test_api_v1_bench 14/14 (contract-checked route, 404 for another tenant, 403 for a taxpayer), test_rsl_intake_bench taxpayer card via the portal, other taxpayers' submissions and unknown requests not found.

Fresh disposable site (frappe_dev.py verify --keep, verify-20261113t132809): install and two migrations ok (incl. the v0_4 patch). Full bench discovery fails on main and here because assistance/test_service imports ai evaluation data from data/synthetic, which docker-compose.frappe.yml does not mount; so every other app test module was run one by one: 59 modules, 841 tests, all OK except reminders/test_reminders_bench (pre-existing on main) and assistance/test_assistance_bench (duplicate synthetic user on the reused site; assistance code untouched). Frappe-free backend 613 with only the Windows path-separator failure; ruff, mypy, eslint, vue-tsc clean; prettier clean on changed files except auditor_queue.json, which already fails on main and keeps its style; vitest domain 44 OK; auditor e2e (Edge) all 65 tests in the touched specs pass with one worker (parallel runs are flaky on main too: 5-17 failures varying per run); validate.py clean. Hosted CI does not start (org spending limit).
